business_summary: Shibaura Mechatronics Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells semiconductor manufacturing, flat panel displays manufacturing, vacuum, and health-related equipment in Japan, China, Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Fine Mechatronics, Mechatronics Systems, Distribution Equipment Systems, and Real Estate Leasing. The company offers cleaning, etching, ashing, semiconductor inspection, and bonding equipment; slice etching, developing, stripping, and panel spin cleaning equipment, as well as IC/COF bonder for flat panel display; sputtering, deposition, and precision parts manufacturing equipment; automatic ticket vending machines; and inkjet tablet printing systems. It also engages in the leasing of office buildings and lands; maintenance, overhauls, machine management, and repair services; engineering service for transfer and setup; parts cleaning, surface treatment and evaluation, and analysis services. The company was formerly known as Shibaura Engineering Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shibaura Mechatronics Corporation in October 1998. Shibaura Mechatronics Corporation was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Fine Mechatronics, Mechatronics Systems, Distribution Equipment Systems 및 Real Estate Leasing의 네 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 세정, 에칭, 애싱, 반도체 검사 및 접합 장비를 제공합니다. 슬라이스 에칭, 현상, 박리, 패널 스핀 클리닝 장비, 평판 디스플레이용 IC/COF 본더; 스퍼터링, 증착, 정밀부품 제조장비; 자동 티켓 판매기; 및 잉크젯 태블릿 인쇄 시스템. 또한 사무실 건물과 토지 임대에도 참여합니다. 유지보수, 정밀검사, 기계 관리 및 수리 서비스; 전송 및 설치를 위한 엔지니어링 서비스; 부품 세척, 표면 처리 및 평가, 분석 서비스. 이 회사는 이전에 Shibaura Engineering Works Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 1998년 10월에 Shibaura Mechatronics Corporation으로 이름을 변경했습니다.
